strategy_roster.name: Suffic369
strategy_roster.notes: The documented SMA(3) versus SMA of highs(5) cross and Bollinger(156,1) lower-band location are retained. The mirrored low-SMA branch, trailing, and point-based stop/target are omitted; no percentage values are supplied.

strategy_roster.name: Gandalf PRO Projection
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(24) versus SMA(24) with positive one-bar momentum is a transparent proxy for the recursive projection direction. The 15-pip projection threshold, adaptive weights, short projection, and pip stop are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Five MA Multi-Timeframe
strategy_roster.entry_long: sma(close,5) > sma(close,8) and sma(close,8) > sma(close,13) and sma(close,13) > sma(close,21) and sma(close,21) > sma(close,34) and roc(close,1) > 0
strategy_roster.exit_long: sma(close,5) < sma(close,8) or sma(close,8) < sma(close,13) or sma(close,13) < sma(close,21) or sma(close,21) < sma(close,34)
strategy_roster.notes: The five documented SMA lengths 5/8/13/21/34 are aligned as a current-timeframe bullish stack with positive ROC. The three timeframe resamplings, Accelerator Oscillator grading, and exact signal levels are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: GBP 9 AM Pending Orders
strategy_roster.notes: A prior 20-bar high break with average volume is a rolling proxy for the London snapshot stop orders; the opposite low break exits. Clock scheduling, pending offsets, pip protection, and one-order state are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Game Theory Trading
strategy_roster.entry_long: rsi(close,14) < 30 and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 2 and close < sma(close,100) - 0.02 * sma(close,100)
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14), normalized volume, and a 2% SMA(100) Nash-deviation band are explicit proxies for the mixed contrarian/momentum rules. Accumulation/distribution, smart-money, liquidity-trap, and institutional-flow logic is unavailable; documented 2%/5% protection is retained.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Hook Reversal
strategy_roster.notes: A new prior 20-bar low followed by an RSI(14) recross above 30 captures the documented oversold hook, with the opposite RSI hook or range break exiting. The 2% stop is retained; exact hook levels, time window, and short side are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: FT TIME BIGDOG Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: A rolling prior ten-bar high break is a stateless proxy for the London accumulation-range stop orders; the opposite low break exits. Start/stop hours, range-width limit, order buffer, and point targets are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: 20/200 Expert
strategy_roster.notes: ROC(open,4) is a permitted proxy for the difference between opens two and six bars back; the inverse is the long exit. The 6/21-point thresholds, 14:00 clock, 504-hour timer, and point stop/target are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Simple Engulfing
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and close > donchian_high_prev(high,1) and open < donchian_low_prev(low,1)
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish candle closing above the prior high while opening below the prior low approximates the documented engulfing pattern. Body filters, direction modes, pip stops/targets, and the sell pattern are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Night Stochastic
strategy_roster.notes: Stochastic is unavailable, so RSI(14) below 30/above 70 is the oversold/overbought proxy; the 21:00–06:00 session cannot be represented. Point stops/targets and the short branch are omitted.
